confounders.name: Incidence angle gradient
confounders.mechanism: GRD calibration LUT varies ~17% across swath. Uncalibrated DN values at different swath positions are not radiometrically comparable.
confounders.mitigation: Apply approximate sigma0 calibration using recovered S3 calibration XMLs
confounders.residual_risk: ~6% systematic bias from block-mean nonlinearity; larger bias at feature boundaries

confounders.name: Block-mean calibration nonlinearity
confounders.mechanism: OPS-01 stores mean(DN). Calibration uses DN^2. By Jensen's inequality, (mean(DN))^2 < mean(DN^2). Approximate calibration systematically underestimates sigma0 by ~6% in homogeneous regions.
confounders.mitigation: Accept systematic bias (0.25 dB, within sensor spec); empirically validate via V-01
confounders.residual_risk: Scene-content-dependent bias at feature boundaries (uncorrectable from block-mean)

confounders.name: Parent scene concentration
confounders.mechanism: 72 TRAIN samples from only 12 parent scenes. One parent contributes 12 tiles, another only 1 tile. Model may memorize scene-specific patterns.
confounders.residual_risk: 12 parents may not represent global maritime diversity; unfixable without new data

confounders.name: Rare-class parent diversity
confounders.mechanism: Eddy appears in 3 tiles from 1 parent. LWA in 2 tiles from 1 parent. HM in 7 tiles from 5 parents (985 pixels total). Model cannot generalize beyond observed parent scenes for these classes.
confounders.mitigation: None available without additional data. Document as limitation.
confounders.residual_risk: Per-class IoU for Eddy, LWA, HM may reflect memorization, not generalization

confounders.name: Zero-pixel border artifacts
confounders.mechanism: 7 samples contain zero-valued border pixels (swath edge padding). In log domain, these become -60 dB artifacts. Source mask labels them BG.
confounders.mitigation: Validity mask: valid=(raw>0); exclude zeros from normalization; map to IGNORE_INDEX in training target
confounders.residual_risk: Validity mask design not empirically validated yet

confounders.name: Dominant-class sampler failure
confounders.mechanism: P0 proposed WeightedRandomSampler with inverse dominant-class frequency. 6/12 classes (AF, Eddy, HM, LWA, OF, RF) are never dominant in any TRAIN tile. These classes receive zero targeted upsampling.
confounders.mitigation: Replace with class-presence-aware or parent-balanced sampler

confounders.name: Sampler x loss double correction
confounders.mechanism: If sampler upweights rare classes AND loss weights also upweight rare classes, the combined effect may be extreme. HM has 147.9x raw loss weight; if also upsampled, effective gradient could destabilize training.
confounders.mitigation: Analyze combined effective class gradient magnitudes (V-04)

confounders.name: BatchNorm instability at small batch size
confounders.mechanism: Both architectures use BatchNorm2d. With batch_size=8 and 72 TRAIN samples, only ~9 batches/epoch. BN running statistics may be poorly estimated.
confounders.mitigation: Consider GroupNorm or InstanceNorm alternative. Verify BN behavior in V-06.
confounders.residual_risk: GroupNorm may underperform BN in some settings

confounders.name: Seed variance with small dataset
confounders.mechanism: 72 TRAIN samples with 12-class imbalanced task. High expected variance between random seeds.
confounders.residual_risk: 3 seeds may be insufficient to characterize variance; true confidence intervals require more runs

confounders.name: Holdout selection bias
confounders.mechanism: HOLDOUT was historically used in model selection for prior experiments. Cannot claim pristine evaluation.
confounders.mitigation: Disclose as HOLDOUT_PARTIALLY_USED_FOR_SELECTION. No post-hoc best-seed selection on holdout.
confounders.residual_risk: Cannot be fully resolved without new holdout data

confounders.name: Geographic concentration
confounders.mechanism: Unknown geographic diversity of 27 parent scenes. All may be from similar regions.
confounders.mitigation: Inspect scene geographic metadata if available

confounders.name: Temporal concentration
confounders.mechanism: Parent scenes span 2015-2023. Sentinel-1 processing baseline changes over time may affect DN characteristics.
confounders.mitigation: Physical calibration normalizes processing changes; processing baseline changes are well-documented

confounders.name: Source annotation quality
confounders.mechanism: Li et al. annotations are the ground truth. Quality, consistency, and inter-annotator agreement are not independently verified for OPS-01 subset.
confounders.mitigation: None available without independent re-annotation. Treat as dataset limitation.
confounders.residual_risk: Model performance bounded by annotation quality

confounders.name: Augmentation orientation validity for SAR
confounders.mechanism: SAR imagery has physical orientation (range direction = incidence angle gradient). Flips along range direction change incidence angle ordering.
confounders.mitigation: At 256x256 tile scale, incidence angle gradient is negligible (~2.5% across tile). Flips classified as CONDITIONALLY SAFE.
